in_marathi.name: Geethika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Geethika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Geethika is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Geetha’, which means a song or melody. The name signifies the rhythm and harmony in life and is often associated with spiritual wisdom and knowledge. The name is also connected to the Hindu epic Mahabharata, where Geetha is the name of the chariot driver of Arjuna. The Bhagavad Gita, a sacred text in Hinduism, is conveyed to Arjuna by Lord Krishna while they are on a battlefield. Geetha thus embodies the harmony and balance that exists within us, guiding us to make the right decisions.
